items.title: For Automakers, RISC-V Isn’t Just About Ownership: It’s About Freedom of Choice
items.summary: MIPS’ Sameer Wasson explains why an automotive OEM’s choice of instruction set architecture (ISA) should prioritize supplier choice, software reuse and long-term economic control. items.title_zh: 对汽车厂商而言，RISC-V的意义不仅是所有权，更是选择自由

items.title: LILYGO T-Dongle-C5 – An ESP32-C5 USB dongle with microSD card slot, optional 0.96-inch OLED
items.summary: LILYGO T-Dongle-C5 is an ESP32-C5 dual-band WiFi 6, BLE, and 802.15.4 USB dongle that builds upon the earlier ESP32-S3-based T-Dongle-S3 board. The new board still features an optional 0.96-inch color display, a microSD card slot, and a USB-A male port. The main differences are support for dual-band WiFi 6, 16MB flash, 8MB PSRAM, and the addition of a Qwiic expansion connector. T-Dongle-C5 specifications: Wireless SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-C5HR8 CPU Single-core 32-bit RISC-V processor @ up to 240 MHz Low-power RISC-V core @ 40 MHz acting as the main processor for power-sensitive applications Memory – 384 KB SRAM on-chip, 8MB PSRAM Storage – 320 KB ROM Wireless Connectivity Dual-band (2.4GHz/5 GHz) 802.11ax WiFi 6, with 802.11b/g/n WiFi 4 standard fallback Bluetooth 5.0 Low Energy (LE) 802.15.4 radio for Zigbee 3.0 and Thread 1.3 Storage 16MB flash MicroSD card socket integrated in the USB connector Fitted with a “virtual TF card”, a [...] The post LILYGO T-Dongle-C5 – An ESP32-C5 USB dongle with microSD card slot, optional 0.96-inch OLED appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: LILYGO推出搭载ESP32-C5的T-Dongle-C5 USB dongle开发板
items.summary_zh: LILYGO发布T-Dongle-C5 USB dongle,基于乐鑫ESP32-C5单核RISC-V处理器(最高240MHz),支持双频WiFi 6、Bluetooth 5.0 LE和802.15.4(Zigbee 3.0/Thread 1.3),配备16MB flash、8MB PSRAM、microSD卡槽及可选0.96英寸彩色OLED屏,新增Qwiic扩展接口。
items.why_it_matters_zh: ESP32-C5采用RISC-V内核,提供低成本双频WiFi 6多协议USB dongle方案,丰富了RISC-V MCU开发板生态。

items.title: Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode
items.summary: Nordic Semiconductor recently expanded its nRF54L Series with the nRF54LC10A, a new SoC with less memory and a smaller peripheral set compared to the higher-end nRF54L15, while supporting Bluetooth LE with Channel Sounding and IEEE 802.15.4 for Thread, Zigbee, and Matter. Built on a 22nm process, the SoC combines a 128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with a multiprotocol 2.4 GHz radio. It also features a sub-50 nA hibernation mode for devices shipped with (3V) batteries installed, reducing battery drain during storage and transportation. Nordic Semiconductor nRF54LC10A specifications CPU Arm Cortex-M33 @ 128 MHz with DSP, FPU, MPU, and TrustZone 128 MHz RISC-V coprocessor (VPR) with I/O acceleration for SoftPeripherals and time-critical offload Performance – 239 CoreMark/mA, 503 CoreMark (preliminary) Memory – 192 KB RAM Storage – Up to 1012 KB NVM Wireless Bluetooth 5.4 LE with direction-finding, Bluetooth Mesh, etc. Ready for future Bluetooth releases Bluetooth Channel Sounding support for [...] The post Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Nordic推出nRF54LC10A SoC：支持蓝牙Channel Sounding与802.15.4
items.summary_zh: Nordic扩展nRF54L系列，发布nRF54LC10A SoC，采用22nm工艺，集成128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33与128 MHz RISC-V协处理器，支持蓝牙5.4 LE Channel Sounding和IEEE 802.15.4（Thread/Zigbee/Matter），休眠电流低于50 nA，适合预装电池设备的存储和运输场景。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内置RISC-V协处理器用于外设加速与关键任务卸载，22nm工艺带来极低功耗表现。

items.title: CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: The AIMORELOGY Ovis is an open-source AI vision camera module built around the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, with full-color 1080p night vision and 1.5 TOPS edge AI inference in a compact modular design. It is designed for drones, robotics, security systems, smart cameras, and custom embedded vision products. The camera features a compact stacked design, with a 20 × 20 mm Core board that includes the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, 2 Gbit NAND flash, USB, and UART debug pads. A Sensor board with the SC235HAI image sensor connects on top and also adds Ethernet and UART interfaces. An optional CVBS board goes between the Sensor board and the Ovis Core board. AIMORELOGY Ovis specifications: Ovis Core Board SoC – CVITEK CV1842H-P CPU – 1x Arm Cortex-A53 core @ 1.1 GHz, 1x RISC-V C906 core @ 800 MHz NPU – 1.5 TOPS @ INT8 with BF16 support ISP – AI-ISP with real-time 1080p [...] The post CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding) appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: AIMORELOGY Ovis开源AI相机模块搭载CVITEK CV1842H-P
items.summary_zh: AIMORELOGY推出开源AI视觉相机模块Ovis，基于CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC，集成Arm Cortex-A53与RISC-V C906双核，配备1.5 TOPS NPU与AI-ISP，支持1080p全彩夜视，采用20×20 mm Core board加Sensor board堆叠设计，适用于无人机、机器人和安防等领域。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开源模块化设计降低边缘AI视觉开发门槛，异构双核兼顾通用计算与AI推理。

items.title: Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers
items.summary: Last year, we saw Morse Micro introduce the MM8108 Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) SoC with up to 43.33 Mbps throughput, along with an MM8108-RD09 USB dongle reference design, for which we had virtually no details at the time. Morse Micro has now released USB-A and USB-C Wi-Fi HaLow adapters based on that reference design. The adapters let PCs and routers connect to 802.11ah networks through USB without a dedicated expansion card and feature an external SMA antenna delivering up to 26 dBm transmit power. Wi-Fi HaLow USB network adapter specifications: SoC – Morse Micro MM8108 32-bit RISC-V Host Applications Processor (HAP) Standard – IEEE802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow Frequency band – 850-950 MHz (Worldwide sub-1 GHz license-exempt range) Operating Modes – Access Point (AP) and Station (STA). Channel Width – 1/2/4/8 MHz Modulation – BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM. Data rate – Up to 43.3 Mbps using 256-QAM modulation at an 8 MHz bandwidth [...] The post Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Morse Micro推出基于RISC-V的Wi-Fi HaLow USB适配器
items.summary_zh: Morse Micro推出基于MM8108 Wi-Fi HaLow（802.11ah）SoC的USB-A和USB-C适配器，SoC内置32位RISC-V处理器。适配器支持AP和STA模式，工作在850-950 MHz频段，最高数据速率43.3 Mbps，配备外置SMA天线，输出功率达26 dBm，PC和路由器可直接通过USB接入HaLow网络。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 首次将Wi-Fi HaLow以USB适配器形式商用，简化了PC和路由器的远距离低功耗Wi-Fi接入部署。

items.title: JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity
items.summary: JetKVM Mini is a smaller, lower-cost version of the popular JetKVM KVM over IP solution. The new model features a small information display, offers Ethernet or WiFi connectivity, and supports 1080p video capture. The main under-the-hood change is that they ditched Linux on a Rockchip RV1106G3 SoC and now rely on an ESP32-P4X (ESP32-P4 version 3.x and greater) to handle video capture, H.264 encoding, USB, and other features. The largest cost saving is removing the RAM and eMMC flash required by Linux. JetKVM Mini specifications: SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-P4X CPU Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V HP (High-performance) CPU @ up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extension and single-precision FPU Single-RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core @ up to 40 MHz Memory 768 KB HP L2MEM (for dual-core CPU), 32 KB LP SRAM, 8 KB TCM (for LP MCU core) 32 MB PSRAM Storage – 128 KB HP ROM, 16 KB LP ROM [...] The post JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini发布：基于ESP32-P4X的低成本KVM方案
items.summary_zh: JetKVM推出Mini版KVM over IP设备，采用ESP32-P4X双核RISC-V SoC替代原Linux+Rockchip RV1106G3方案，去掉RAM和eMMC闪存以降低成本。设备支持1080p视频采集与H.264编码，提供以太网或WiFi连接，并配小型信息显示屏。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 用ESP32-P4X裸机方案替代Linux系统，显著降低物料成本，推动KVM over IP设备向消费级普及。

items.title_zh: Redox OS 新增类 IO_uring API 与 NUMA 支持，QEMU 运行已可用
items.summary_zh: Rust 编写的开源操作系统 Redox OS 近期迎来多项重要更新，新增类 IO_uring 异步 I/O API 和 NUMA 支持，并成功在 QEMU 模拟器中运行。这些改进显著提升了系统的异步 I/O 性能与多节点可扩展性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Rust 系统软件生态持续完善，为操作系统领域带来全新的高性能异步 I/O 与 NUMA 实现方案。

items.title: Approaching A 10 Second Linux Kernel Build
items.summary: The coffee window is closing. Going back many years with the time it's taken to compile the Linux kernel has been a well known opportunity for a coffee break or even eating a meal during the lengthy Linux kernel build process. Even when the Linux kernel was much smaller than it is today, with the hardware at the time it would often be a very time consuming process... Thus incredible to think that we are now on the horizon of a ten second clean, default kernel build on Linux x86_64.
items.title_zh: Linux x86_64 内核干净构建时间逼近 10 秒大关
items.summary_zh: Linux x86_64 默认配置的干净内核构建时间正逼近 10 秒大关。曾几何时，编译内核足以让人悠闲喝杯咖啡甚至吃顿饭，如今随着编译器与构建工具链的持续优化，这一耗时已大幅缩短，预示着 Linux 内核开发效率的进一步飞跃。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内核构建速度的飞跃将显著提升开发者迭代效率，加速 Linux 内核演进节奏。

items.title: Patches Posted For Enabling NVMe On All Apple M3 Based SoCs With Linux
items.summary: While Linux 7.2 brought initial Apple M3 support and Linux 7.3 brought M3 Pro / Max / Ultra support, the mainline Linux kernel support for the M3 series hardware remains very basic and not yet ready for daily driving. But more work continues to be upstreamed and today the patches were posted for getting NVMe storage up and running across all Apple M3 hardware...
items.title_zh: 补丁发布：Linux在所有Apple M3 SoC上启用NVMe存储
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.2带来初步Apple M3支持，7.3加入M3 Pro/Max/Ultra支持，但M3系列硬件的主流Linux内核支持仍非常基础，不适合日常使用。最新发布的补丁可让所有Apple M3硬件运行NVMe存储。
items.why_it_matters_zh: NVMe存储是基础I/O环节，其支持推进了Apple Silicon设备在Linux上日常可用的进程。

items.title: Linux Kernel Developers Consider Adding AGENTS.md To Help Guide AI/LLM Agents
items.summary: While the Linux kernel continues to be bombarded with patches from AI/LLM agents, to date the kernel hasn't carried an AGENTS.md Markdown file with instructions catering to AI/LLM agents. But a patch set out today would finally introduce one...
items.title_zh: Linux内核开发者考虑加入AGENTS.md以引导AI/LLM代理
items.summary_zh: 尽管Linux内核不断收到来自AI/LLM代理的补丁，但内核至今没有面向AI代理的AGENTS.md说明文件。今日发布的补丁集将首次引入该文件，为AI代理提供行为指引。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AGENTS.md有望规范AI生成代码的提交流程，减少低质量补丁涌入，维护评审效率。

items.title: AMD Posts GCC Compiler Patches For AVX10V1AUX ISA Support
items.summary: Following their recent AVX10_V2_AUX support for GCC as part of the bring-up for the AI Compute Extensions "ACE" in GCC 17, AMD compiler engineers this week posted the initial patches for enabling the AVX10V1AUX ISA support...
items.title_zh: AMD 为 GCC 提交 AVX10V1AUX ISA 支持补丁
items.summary_zh: 继为 GCC 17 添加 AVX10_V2_AUX 支持以推进 AI Compute Extensions（ACE）开发之后，AMD 编译器工程师本周提交了启用 AVX10V1AUX ISA 支持的初始补丁。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AVX10 是 AMD 面向 AI 和高性能计算的关键向量扩展，编译器层面的支持完善意味着硬件生态正在推进。

items.title: Linux Kernel Introducing New Taint Due To Fuzzing Bots Yielding Impractical Bug Reports
items.summary: The Linux kernel is having to introduce a new taint flag "TAINT_FORCED_BIND" to deal with fuzzing bots like Syzbot abusing Linux's bind/unbind sysfs functionality and generating bug reports for impractical and not at all relevant hardware/driver combinations...
items.title_zh: Linux 内核新增 Taint 标志以应对模糊测试机器人产生无效缺陷报告
items.summary_zh: Linux 内核将引入新的 taint 标志 TAINT_FORCED_BIND，以应对 Syzbot 等模糊测试机器人滥用 bind/unbind sysfs 功能，从而生成与硬件/驱动组合无关、不切实际的缺陷报告。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该机制有助于维护者过滤噪声报告，提升内核缺陷处理的效率。

items.title: CyboPal ONE – An AI-powered, 6-DOF robotic terminal with 27-inch 4K display that adjusts to your posture (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: CyboPal ONE is a 6-axis desktop robotic terminal designed to move a 27-inch 4K display using voice and gesture control, spatial sensing, and automatic display positioning based on the user’s position. It includes a camera, a binocular 3D sensor, and a motion sensor (IMU), and supports joint force sensing, obstacle avoidance, collision detection, and power-loss soft landing. The 6-DOF arm has a 747 mm reach and supports face tracking, manual adjustment, and saved positions. A built-in Pauli agent also provides voice control for screen positioning, application control, text input, and workflow tasks across Windows, macOS, and Linux. items.title_zh: CyboPal ONE：搭载AI的6自由度桌面机器人显示终端
items.summary_zh: CyboPal ONE是一款6轴桌面机器人终端，可通过语音、手势和空间感知自动调节27英寸4K显示屏的位置与角度，搭载Rockchip RK3588八核处理器，配备双目3D传感器和IMU，支持Windows、macOS和Linux系统，臂展747毫米，目前正在众筹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将机械臂技术与AI空间感知结合，为桌面显示交互提供全新人机工程学方案。

items.title: Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 and PCIe Edge AI cards, BrainBoard 1500 SPI module now available for $99 and up
items.summary: Back in November 2025, we wrote about the Brainchip AKD1500 PCIe/SPI Edge AI co-processor designed for low-power systems and delivering up to 800 GOPS at just 300 mW. In recent months, the company has launched several hardware platforms based on the ADK1500. At the end of July, Brainchip introduced the AKD1500 M.2 B+M Key development card for $129, shortly followed by the $99 BrainBoard 1500 module in August, and a few days ago, the company started selling the AKD1500 PCIe development card for $149. items.title_zh: Brainchip AKD1500 M.2/PCIe边缘AI开发卡上市，起售价99美元
items.summary_zh: Brainchip推出基于AKD1500神经形态协处理器的多款开发平台，功耗仅300mW即可提供800 GOPS算力，支持片上自适应学习。BrainBoard 1500 SPI模块售价99美元，M.2 B+M Key开发卡129美元，PCIe开发卡149美元，面向低功耗边缘AI应用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 低功耗神经形态计算为端侧AI推理提供高能效解决方案。
